chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him) about a man who performs *zihar* with his slave-girl, so he said: 'The free woman and the slave-girl are equal in this.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of zihar when applied to a slave-girl?
ai.summary: Reported by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the legal ruling of *zihar* applies equally to slave-girls (*jariyah*) and free women (*hurrah*). This establishes a key principle in Shia jurisprudence that the specific status of concubinage does not exempt the slave from the same marital obligations and expiations as a free wife, reinforcing the universality of the ruling across social classes.
